proposal.description: The ceiling-step test copies the at-or-past (>=) form of the target test, while the step-window counter still wraps only on equality. A cycles_per_step lowered below the running count therefore steps the ceiling on every switching cycle until the counter wraps.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, if the host lowers cycles_per_step below the current cycle_counter mid-ramp, max_on_counts rises by one on every PWM falling edge, racing to max_on_limit and raising SS_done early. In the original the ceiling does not step until the counter wraps and reaches the new window end.

proposal.description: Reaching the target also clears the step-window counter, as if a finished ramp should re-arm its window. The window then restarts on every at-target clock instead of running on every switching cycle of S_SS.
proposal.reason: With ss_active held after the ceiling reaches max_on_limit, raising max_on_limit makes the next ceiling step land a full cycles_per_step cycles after the raise. In the original it lands at the end of the window already running.

proposal.description: On a ramp step SS_done is assigned from the look-ahead comparison instead of only being set by it. Each step that does not land on the target therefore clears a SS_done that was already latched in S_SS.
proposal.reason: In S_SS after SS_done has risen, if max_on_limit is raised above the ceiling while ss_active stays high, the next ceiling step drops SS_done to 0. In the original SS_done stays set until the module leaves S_SS and S_RUN.
